verdict.rationale: The project-local half is well evidenced. `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project's `.agents/skills` and `.claude/skills` directories, a hands-on dry run confirmed this, and the docs say these files can be committed to share the setup with a team. The user-global half is weak: the only global install shown is the CLI binary itself (`npm install -g`), with no documented option to install the skills or instructions user-wide (e.g. into home-directory harness folders) as an alternative scope. Missing for 10: a documented user-global scope option for skills/instructions, an explicit scope choice in `init`, independent corroboration.
